text:
mira: Ran the kv-cache heavy perf harness on master and hit intermittent OOMs on p100 canaries. Repro/notes below.

mira: CI job: https://ci.internal/teams/eng-runtime/jobs/4521 :eyes:

mira: Repro command (local):
```
python -m perf.driver --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --kv-cache --iters 100 --seed 42
```

mira: Snapshot of allocator knobs in the failing run: `expandable_segments=true`, `max_split_size_mb=128`, `garbage_collection_threshold=0.6`

mira: OOM trace:
```
E cuda: out of memory when calling cudaMalloc 123456789
W allocator: split growth triggered (requested 3.1GB, available 2.9GB)
I kvcache: prefix warmup allocated 1.8GB then freed
```

josh: Thanks for the repro. I suspect split churn + small alloc/free pattern from KV cache warmup is creating fragmentation. Did you capture an alloc/free flame or NVTX timeline?

mira: Attached a quick nvtx timeline and heap profile. Flame shows many ~16-64KB frees interleaved with occasional 1-2MB allocs. Fragmentation metric (heap_reserved/heap_active) climbs to ~0.82 before OOM.

anika: If fragmentation is the driver, turning off `expandable_segments` often helps by avoiding small split growths. Try `expandable_segments=false` + bumping `max_split_size_mb` to 384 or 512 to reduce split frequency. Also set `garbage_collection_threshold=0.75` so we GC earlier.

sam: Another angle: kernel routing changed earlier to prefer the new attention kernel which increases temporary workspace peak for seq>1024. We could gate that kernel behind `seq_threshold=2048` for a canary to lower peak (fallback to fused kernel when workspace would exceed 1.2x).

mira: I ran an A/B: `expandable_segments=false` + `max_split_size_mb=384` + `garbage_collection_threshold=0.75` => 100 runs with no OOMs, tail latency +2% p50 unchanged, token cost ~-8% (fewer GC cycles). Repro scripts + flamegraph: https://perf.internal/fg/2175001111

josh: Nice. Can you push a small experiment to perfbench config so we can run across instance types (p100/v100/a100)? We need to validate it doesn't regress throughput for batched reranking workloads.

anika: I'll open a PR with the experiment matrix and a playbook: when OOM rate spikes >3/hr, flip `expandable_segments=false`, increase `max_split_size_mb` by 3x, bump `garbage_collection_threshold`, and trigger `cudaEmptyCache()` between heavy KV-cache batches as a temporary mitigation.

infra-bot: CI pipeline: perf-experiment/alloc-knobs #783 started (canary)

devops-bot: Canary rollout 10% in us-west-2 scheduled at 03:15 UTC

mira: Added repro script and nvprof output to the ticket. If this holds across GPUs, we should make the perfbench experiment default for the KV-cache profile.

josh: Agreed. Also add monitoring for `fragmentation_ratio` and `kvcache_miss_rate` so we can rollback if miss rate increases. :thumbsup:

anika: Will do. Thanks all.
